video.title: AI欧腐《如何勾引我的敌人总裁/How to Seduce My Enemy CEO》
video.desc:
尴尬的是亲亲都在开头 以防阿b查得严剪掉了
He was sent to destroy the Vance family. Instead, he slept with its CEO. Darien is the forgotten son of Hale Capital, desperate to save his mother and claim his place. Emmett Vance is the cold, powerful heir of the enemy empire—until one drunk night cracks him open. They meet again across an interview table. Neither can forget. Neither can stop. Darien is lying about everything. Emmett is hiding a war of his own. And the truth about his parents’ deaths is about to tear both families apart. When the board turns, the traps close, and the blood debts come due—will Darien choose the mission or the man? Can Emmett forgive the spy who stole his heart? Or will their families destroy them before they can choose each other?

他奉命去摧毁 Vance 家族，结果却睡了 Vance 家的总裁。Darien 是 Hale Capital 被遗忘的儿子，一心想救母亲、夺回属于自己的位置。Emmett Vance 是敌对商业帝国的继承人，冷漠而强势，直到一个醉酒的夜晚让他卸下了防备。再次相遇，两人隔着一张面试桌。谁都忘不掉，谁都停不下来。Darien 的一切都是谎言，Emmett 也藏着一场属于自己的战争，而他父母死亡的真相，即将把两个家族撕得粉碎。当董事会倒戈、陷阱收网、血债到了偿还之时，Darien 会选择任务，还是选择那个男人？Emmett 能原谅这个偷走他心的卧底吗？还是说，没等他们选择彼此，两个家族就会先毁掉他们？
